proposed_english: establisher / one who sets in order
rationale: Compound: ⲣⲉϥ- ('one who does') + ⲥⲙⲓⲛⲉ ('to set, fix, establish, order'). Standard agentive formation paralleling ⲣⲉϩ†ⲥⲃⲱ 'teacher' (already in glossary). Here ⲡⲛⲁⲟ̄ ⲛ̄ⲣⲉϩⲥⲙⲓⲛⲉ 'the great Establisher' = the Demiurge / Living Spirit who fixed all the creation in its cosmic order. Functions as cosmological-architectonic title alongside ⲡⲛⲁⲃ ⲛⲉⲕⲱⲧ 'Great Builder' and ⲡⲛⲁⲃ̄ ⲛⲁⲣⲭⲓⲧⲉⲕⲧⲱⲛ 'Great Architect.'

Greek loanword δημιουργός 'craftsman, world-fashioner.' The Lycopolitan ⲁⲏ for δη is dialectal. Standard philosophical-theological term retained as 'Demiurge' to preserve technical specificity. In Manichaean cosmogony positively identified with the Living Spirit / Great Builder rather than (as in some Gnostic systems) with a deficient lower creator.
Greek δίδυμος 'twin' with Lycopolitan ⲁⲓⲁⲩ for ⲓⲇⲩ-. First zodiacal sign in this kephalaion's enumeration, paired with Sagittarius and assigned to the world of Smoke (= Mind).
Greek τοξότης 'archer, bowman.' Standard zodiacal sign retained as 'Archer.' Paired with the Twins in the world of Smoke.
Greek κριός 'ram.' Zodiacal sign assigned to the world of Fire (paired with Lion/Leo).

Greek λέων 'lion.' Distinct here from ⲡⲙⲟⲩⲓ̈ (native Coptic 'lion' for the King of Darkness's head); ⲡⲗⲉⲱⲛ is the Greek loan reserved for the zodiacal sign Leo. Paired with Aries in the world of Fire.
Greek ταῦρος. Zodiacal sign in the world of Wind.
Greek ὑδροχόος 'water-pourer.' Lycopolitan ⲍⲩⲁⲣⲏⲭⲟⲟⲥ shows ⲍ for ⲩⲇ- and ⲭ for χ. In the world of Wind alongside Taurus and Libra.
Greek ζυγός 'yoke, scales, balance.' Standard zodiacal Libra. World of Wind.
Greek καρκίνος 'crab.' Zodiacal Cancer in the world of Water.
Greek παρθένος. Distinguished here from the cosmological ⲧⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲙⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ 'Virgin of Light': this ⲡⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ is the masculine-articled zodiacal sign Virgo (in the world of Water).
Greek ἰχθύς 'fish' as zodiacal sign. World of Water.

Greek αἰγόκερως 'goat-horn.' Translated literally 'Goat-Horn' (rather than transliterated 'Capricorn') to preserve the compound's correspondential force — the figure IS the goat-horn, the dark-world sign of inverted ascent. In the world of Darkness paired with Scorpion.
Greek σκορπίος. Zodiacal sign assigned to the world of Darkness — removed here from the classical water-triplicity, fitting the venomous/destructive correspondence with the deepest dark register.

Greek ἀντίδικος 'opponent at law, adversary.' Used here in cosmic register: the twelve zodiac-signs and five planets are 'enemies and adversaries to one another' (ϫⲁϫⲉ ⲍⲓ ⲁⲛⲧⲓⲁⲕⲟⲥ), held in their courses only by the Demiurge's binding within the sphere.

Greek συλάω 'plunder, despoil.' Cf. ⲁⲗⲱⲭϩ̅ in glossary as similar plunder-verb. Used here of the zodiac-archons mutually plundering one another through the energeia of the cosmic sphere — the war-among-archons motif characteristic of Manichaean astrological cosmology.

Greek ἐπίτροπος 'steward, overseer, agent.' Cosmological role: the divine stewards set over the bound zodiac-archons to compel them and demand from them what they hold of the upper place — i.e., the cosmic accounting-system that extracts captured light from the archonic agency.
Apparent Lycopolitan reduction of ⲟⲩⲁ 'one.' Found in ⲛ̄ⲉⲱ ⲛⲍⲉ 'one to another' (= ⲛⲉⲩⲉⲣⲏⲩ) and ⲁⲉⲱ ⲙ̄ⲙⲁ 'each to a place.' Confidence moderate; awaits parallels.

Coptic ϩⲧⲣ 'force, compel, urge.' In the cosmic-stewardship triplet: the upper-place demanders compel the bound archons to yield up what is theirs. Pairs with ⲱⲓⲧⲉ 'demand' (in glossary) in the extraction-economy of the sphere.
